newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot domestic gas prices slip with weather.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot domestic gas prices slip with weather.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were narrowly mixed Thursday as cooler weather in Alberta pressured prices there but extended NYMEX strength supported prices at the export points, sources said.
Spot gas at Alberta's AECO storage hub slipped one cent to C$1.44-1.47 per gigajoule. August AECO was offered at C$1.43.
According to Weather Services Corp, temperature highs in Calgary were back in the mid-70s F, which gave some buyers the opportunity to inject more gas into storage.
About 755 million cubic feet of gas was injected into storage Wednesday, a trader said, noting a heftier amount was expected to be pumped in today.
At Sumas, Wash., prices on average rose two cents to about $1.08-1.09 per million British thermal units.
In the East, prices at Niagara climbed another two cents to about $2.33 per mmBtu as NYMEX's August Henry Hub gas futures rose to a high of $2.175, widening its margin to last week by 2.7 cents.
